templates.title: Open Code Review (Native Anthropic)
templates.instructions: Place at ~/.opencodereview/config.json. Pick this variant for Claude models: it speaks the Messages API end to end. `provider` selects the gateway entry under `custom_providers`; `model` is the gateway's default model and `models` lists every model this key reaches, so `ocr review --model <name>` can pick another. Gateway MCP servers go under `mcp_servers`, which Open Code Review offers to its review agent as tools; each sends `X-App-Id: open-code-review`, since its MCP client sends only Go's generic User-Agent. Open Code Review sends no telemetry unless `OCR_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1` is set; its npm launcher checks the npm registry for a newer release unless `OCR_NO_UPDATE=1` is set.

templates.title: Open Code Review · MCP only (static key)
templates.instructions: Merge into ~/.opencodereview/config.json beside your existing provider settings. No LLM key is minted in this flow. Open Code Review offers each server's tools to its review agent; each server sends `X-App-Id: open-code-review`, since its MCP client sends only Go's generic User-Agent.
